card.name: Words just before a number or quote
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, by, at, or, be) and partway-through words in text where a number or an opening quote comes next. Often seen before dose amounts, day numbers or dates.

modes.label: Linking word before a number
modes.description: A short word like by, at, or, on that leads straight into a numeral.

modes.label: Days before day numbers
modes.description: The word Days in dosing schedules, followed by day numbers.

modes.label: Partway through capitalised words
modes.description: Middle of a long word in all-caps label text.

card.writes: It makes a number digit less likely next and makes an opening quotation mark more likely.
card.plain: It fires on small words that usually come right before a number, such as the 'by' in 'divisible by 400'.
